ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; ventral surface is approximately 98% low-intensity black/dark-gray with sparse high-intensity white interruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-gray/black distribution across both lobes; no large contiguous geometric white blobs detected; high-contrast pixels are limited to isolated points and linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the superior boundary of both lobes; peaks show variable pixel-amplitude with higher density of sharp valleys on the distal halves of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave arc extending from the median notch toward the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white on black) scattered across both lobes, specifically in the lower-medial and lower-lateral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear pixel streaks detected; one long diagonal high-intensity line on the left lobe and multiple shorter, multi-directional lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, high-intensity textured clusters on the distal tips of both lobes indicative of heavy localized surface disruption; multiple unaligned white linear rake marks visible across the ventral surface.
